description: Add .claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log and .claude/cam-plan-out-*.log ignore globs to templates/.gitignore so cam-init-seeded downstream projects avoid the clean-tree false-halt, and regenerate the embedded templates copy.

userStories.title: Ignore worker-out and plan-out logs in templates/.gitignore and regenerate embed
userStories.description: As a downstream operator whose project was seeded by cam init, I need the templates/.gitignore seed to ignore the per-invocation cam-worker-out and cam-plan-out log files so that cam next / cam plan runs do not dirty the working tree and trigger the clean-tree false-halt that CAM-158 fixed only in the cam-cli repo-root .gitignore.
acceptanceCriteria: templates/.gitignore contains the exact glob line `.claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log`. [oracle: grep -qxF '.claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log' templates/.gitignore]
templates/.gitignore contains the exact glob line `.claude/cam-plan-out-*.log`. [oracle: grep -qxF '.claude/cam-plan-out-*.log' templates/.gitignore]

The edit is surgical: no existing pattern in templates/.gitignore is removed or reordered (the diff against main contains no deletion lines for templates/.gitignore). [oracle: ! git diff main -- templates/.gitignore | grep -q '^-[^-]']
The repo-root .gitignore is untouched (CAM-158 already fixed it; do not re-touch). [oracle: git diff main -- .gitignore | wc -l | grep -qx '0']
The embedded copy is regenerated: `bun run embed-vendor` was run and the updated src/vendor/_generated.ts is committed. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine is green (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: templates/.gitignore (add the two glob lines), src/vendor/_generated.ts (regenerated by `bun run embed-vendor`; it is the single generated source consumed by src/templates/embedded.ts and src/vendor/embedded.ts). Mirror the EXACT globs from repo-root .gitignore lines 59/61: `.claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log` and `.claude/cam-plan-out-*.log` (globs, not literal per-invocation filenames; note the leading dot in .cam-worker-out but NOT in cam-plan-out). Place the two lines coherently next to the existing CAM-68 `.claude/.cam-*` marker block already in templates/.gitignore (the block ending with `.claude/cam-recycle-watcher.log`), each with a short provenance comment (CAM-160). Gotcha: templates/ is embedded into the binary by scripts/generate-embedded-vendor.ts; any templates/ edit MUST be followed by `bun run embed-vendor` and the regenerated file committed, or the embed-vendor:check gate fails (test/embedded.test.ts byte-parity will also catch drift). OUT OF SCOPE: reconciling any other drift between templates/.gitignore and the repo-root .gitignore; touching the repo-root .gitignore; changing the log filename patterns themselves. Issue spec source: scripts/cam/issues/CAM-0160.json (auditor finding from CAM-158 plan-audit, F-02).
